title: Growth estimate for the number of crossing limit cycles in planar piecewise polynomial vector fields
summary: Motivated by the classical Hilbert's Sixteenth Problem, we extend some main developments obtained for Hilbert's number in the polynomial setting to the piecewise polynomial context. Specifically, we study the growth of the maximum number of crossing limit cycles in planar piecewise polynomial vector fields of degree $n$, denoted by $H_c(n)$. The best previously known general lower bound is $H_c(n)\geq 2n - 1$.
